Nested routes compose route layouts with an Outlet; navigation can be declarative with Link or imperative
for events.
Nested route එකක් parent layout එක ඇතුJළේ child page එක Jපන්වනවා. Outlet එJකන් child content
A dashboard layout shows shared navigation for settings and orders.
Read the diagram: Child routes render inside the parent Outlet.

function Layout() { return <><nav><Link to="orders">Orders</Link></nav><Outlet /></>; }
<Route path="dashboard" element={<Layout />}>
  <Route path="orders" element={<Orders />} />
</Route>
Expected result: /dashboard/orders renders Orders within Layout.

Interview question: What is Outlet?
Answer: A placeholder where a matched child route renders.
Remember: Shared shell plus nested page.
